title: rel0-4-0: Sidecar 0.4.0 mods, OS 1.73 (older)
description: The mods for Sidecar 0.4.0 on OS 1.73, for a Rytm you keep on 1.73 (Elektron offers only 1.74 now): everything in rel0-3-1, plus the pan and route report master FX's through mode needs, MD's own page, the JUNO / 6-OP FM preset browser and DSP SAMPLE's sample picker on knob A of SRC, list knobs of up to 36 names, the MIDI machine (machine 50) and the arpeggiator's page (UP + FLTR); the Sidecar's SRC view comes back after a BANK tap, and a drawing race that could make the animated SRC pages flicker is fixed. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.4.0.elemod with version 1.73 (sha256 07780e9e...bff18). Goes with Sidecar 0.4.0 on the Pi.
